Remark
[Cheeger comparison for unions of balls]

Source: petersen:page-0325 ↗ lem:pet-ch7-relative-volume-comparison 1. ch7:7.5.18Suppose $(M^n,g)$ has $\Ric \ge (n-1)k$.

  1. For $p_1,\dots ,p_k\in M$, show $r\mapsto \vol \big(\bigcup _{i=1}^kB(p_i,r)\big)/v(n,k,r)$ is nonincreasing and converges to $k$ as $r\to 0$.

  2. For $A\subset M$, show $r\mapsto \vol \big(\bigcup _{p\in A}B(p,r)\big)/v(n,k,r)$ is nonincreasing, by applying (1) to a dense finite subset of $A$.
